facts.business: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd develops, owns, and operates utility-scale renewable energy projects (solar, wind, hybrid) and is expanding into Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE) to provide reliable, round-the-clock clean power.

guidance_or_targets.statement: India's Net Zero pledge by 2070 as the horizon; ACME Solar is architecting a future combining scale with steadfastness and vision with delivery.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts (references to 'Independent Auditor', 'Statutory Auditor', 'Secretarial Auditor' without firm name)

key_risks: Execution risk on large capital expenditure and capitalisation of projects
Regulatory and policy changes in renewable energy sector
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are placed before the Audit Committee for prior approval, are at arm's length basis, in the ordinary course of business, and in accordance with the Companies Act, SEBI Listing Regulations, and the Company's Related Party Transactions Policy. Details are in Notes 6 & 15 of financial statements.
